verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents event-triggered flows: merchants set up flows based on Klaviyo events to send notifications automatically, and every plan includes building automations. A community user confirms you can tag site events and act on them, for example with an automatic win-back email. The depth of rule definition is thin in the evidence, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: documentation of rule logic (trigger filters, conditional branching, delays), the range of supported actions beyond messaging, programmatic or AI-native definition of flows (via the API or MCP), and hands-on corroboration of complex rule setups.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Merchants can set up flows based on Klaviyo events to send out branded notifications to both the [gift] recipient and the customer.
